retired.source: #overlay #hubMain.pg.hub.base-camp .person-pool-card { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; min-width:0; max-width:215px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:var(--camp-ink); box-shadow:none; cursor:pointer; }

#overlay #hubMain.pg.hub.base-camp .person-pool-toolbar :is(input,select) { width:210px; padding:9px 12px; background:#ffffff70; border:1px solid var(--camp-line); border-radius:0; font:18px/1.4 var(--font-ui); min-height:44px; color:var(--camp-ink); }
#overlay #hubMain.pg.hub.base-camp .pool-type-tabs .mini-btn { white-space:nowrap; min-height:44px; padding:9px 18px; font-size:19px; background:none; color:var(--camp-muted); border:0; }

#overlay#overlay #hubMain.pg.hub.base-camp.base-frame-v7.base-subpage :is(.warehouse-toolbar,.person-pool-toolbar,.collection-browse-tools) > span { margin-left:auto; color:var(--camp-muted); font:17px/1.4 var(--font-ui); white-space:nowrap; }

#overlay#overlay #hubMain.pg.hub.base-camp.base-frame-v7.base-subpage .warehouse-categories-v7 button::before { content:''; width:8px; height:8px; flex:none; transform:rotate(45deg); background:#a9b0a980; }
#overlay#overlay #hubMain.pg.hub.base-camp.base-frame-v7.base-subpage .personnel-v12 .person-pool-toolbar { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; padding:14px 0; margin:0; border:0; }
& .pv12-pool-catalog { grid-column:1; grid-row:2; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; min-width:0; min-height:0; padding:0; overflow:hidden; }
& .person-pool-toolbar { flex-wrap:nowrap; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:0 0 10px; border-bottom:1px solid #bac3c9; }
& .card-browser-track { --card-browser-min:320px; gap:24px; flex:1; min-height:0; padding:6px 10px; align-content:center; justify-content:center; overflow-y:auto; }

& .person-pool-card { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-width:0; width:100%; max-width:none; gap:16px; padding:18px 20px 12px; border:0; border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:#f0f4f3; box-sizing:border-box; box-shadow:none; }
& .pool-card-art { display:block; pointer-events:none; width:272px; max-width:100%; height:auto; aspect-ratio:272/406; overflow:visible; margin:0; filter:none; }
& .pool-card-art > .hs-card { width:100%!important; max-width:none!important; min-width:0!important; margin:0; transform:none; font-size:16px; }
& .person-pool-card > span:last-child { position:relative; top:6px; color:#bccbd0; font-size:var(--base-type-label,21px); line-height:24px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.08em; }
& .card-browser-page { width:48px; height:38px; border:1px solid #9cabb3; border-radius:8px; background:#f6f8f9; color:#25333b; }

& .hub-page:has(> :is(.warehouse-v3.warehouse-v2,.trade-v5.trade-v12)) { box-sizing:border-box; height:100%; min-height:0; max-height:100%; overflow:hidden; background:transparent; padding:24px 30px; }

#overlay#overlay #hubMain.pg.hub.base-camp.base-frame-v7.base-subpage .collection-v12-stage { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(250px,1fr) minmax(240px,.75fr); gap:30px; min-height:300px; flex:1; padding:26px; border:1px solid var(--camp-line); border-radius:20px; background:var(--base-v12-glass,#17262d); backdrop-filter:none; }

#overlay#overlay #hubMain.pg.hub.base-camp.base-frame-v7.base-subpage .collection-v12-info dl div { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:15px; padding:14px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--camp-line); }

#overlay#overlay #hubMain.pg.hub.base-camp.base-frame-v7.base-subpage .collection-v12 .card-browser { --card-browser-min:115px; --card-browser-gap:12px; flex:none; padding:14px; border:1px solid var(--camp-line); border-radius:16px; background:var(--base-v12-glass); }

#overlay#overlay #hubMain.pg.hub.base-camp.base-frame-v7.base-subpage .collection-v12 .collection-card { min-height:0; padding:8px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:9px; background:transparent; }

#overlay#overlay #hubMain.pg.hub.base-camp.base-frame-v7.base-subpage .collection-v12 .collection-browse-tools { gap:12px; margin:0; padding:12px; border:1px solid var(--camp-line); border-radius:14px; background:var(--base-v12-glass); }

#overlay#overlay #hubMain.pg.hub.base-camp.base-frame-v7.base-subpage .collection-v12 .collection-browse-tools :is(input,select) { background:#ffffff0a; color:var(--camp-ink); border:1px solid var(--camp-line); border-radius:8px; font-size:16px; }

#overlay#overlay #hubMain.pg.hub.base-camp.base-frame-v7.base-subpage .collection-v12[data-empty="true"] .collection-empty { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:16px; flex:1; min-height:360px; margin:0; padding:30px; border:1px solid var(--camp-line); border-radius:20px; background:var(--base-v12-glass,#17262d); backdrop-filter:none; }

body #overlay#overlay#overlay#overlay #hubMain.base-frame-v7 .collection-v12-info [data-act="collectionV12Zoom"] { align-self:flex-start; flex:none; width:auto; min-width:0; min-height:48px; padding:10px 18px; margin-top:10px; font-size:var(--base-type-body,22px); background:#ffffff0b; border:1px solid var(--camp-line); color:var(--camp-ink); }
body #overlay .card.bag-page .bag-v2 .bag-rz:hover:enabled { color: #f2f4f6; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08); transform: translateY(-1px); }
body #overlay .pearl-store .battle-decision-head h3 { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; font-size:34px; }
body #overlay .pearl-store .pearl-store-columns h4 { margin:0; color:#e4edf0; font-size:28px; line-height:1.4; }

body #overlay .pearl-store .pearl-store-card { display:block; width:272px; max-width:100%; margin:0; padding:0; border:0; border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:#e4edf0; font:inherit; text-align:center; cursor:pointer; }
body #overlay .pearl-store .pearl-store-caption { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; padding:12px 8px; background:#1b3441; font-size:24px; line-height:1.4; }
body #overlay .pearl-store .ov-empty { grid-column:1/-1; margin:0; padding:24px 0; color:#b9cbd4; font-size:22px; line-height:1.6; text-align:left; }
